findings.detail: each of the 3 records is sealed by this book's own signer and by no other party; its content is this node's own statement
1 controller binding records name the signing key; their signatures are not checked, so the key is not shown bound
the latest checkpoint covers all 3 records
no witness is configured: no checkpoint is delivered to one
no received answer in this book carries an unchecked property
range, correlation and full_history are answered to no one except through a recipient-specific derivation; every derivation other than history_card/1 is refused derivation_unsupported
this book publishes no commitment document, so whether the policy digest is in one is not checked
checkpoints and history_card/1 (commitments only, no record); every other subject is refused not_authorized
what a stranger receives; record and exchange subjects are refused until a record names it as counterparty, and then it receives those records
